blocks.text: Jandar bairooni aur andarooni muharrikat (stimuli) par radd-e-amal karte hain. Janwar jawab mein jagah badal sakte hain, magar pode ek jagah jame hain, is liye woh sirf apni nashonuma ka tareeqa badal sakte hain.

blocks.title: Tropic harkatein
blocks.text: Kisi muharrik (stimulus) se shuru hone wali podon ki nashonuma ki harkatein majmui taur par tropic movements ya tropisms kehlati hain. Yeh poore uzw (organ) ke roshni, chhoone, kimiyai maddon, pani aur gravity jaise muharrik ki taraf ya us se door murne ki shakal mein hoti hain.

items: Phototropism roshni ke jawab mein pode ke hisse ki harkat hai, jo tane ya jar jaise hisse ki mukhtalif-raftar (differential) nashonuma se hoti hai. Shoot ke sire aam taur par musbat (positive) phototropism dikhate hain, jarein manfi (negative) phototropism.
Geotropism gravity ke jawab mein harkat hai: jarein musbat geotropism dikhati hain aur shoots manfi geotropism.

Thigmotropism chhoone ke jawab mein harkat hai, jaise charhne wali belon (climbing vines) mein: jab tendril kisi thos cheez ko chhooti hai to rabte se door wali taraf nashonuma barh jati hai aur tendril sahare ke gird lipat jati hai.
Chemotropism kimiyai maddon ke jawab mein harkat hai; phaphoondi (fungi) ke hyphae chemotropic hain.

blocks.alt: Chaar khaane. Phototropism: pauda suraj (light) ki taraf mura hai aur jar mitti mein neeche. Geotropism: beej se shoot upar aur jar neeche barhti hai, neela teer gravity dikhata hai. Thigmotropism: bel ka tendril sahare (support) ki lakri ke gird lipta hai. Chemotropism: fungus ki hypha chemical wale daire ki taraf barhti hai.
blocks.caption: Chaar tropisms: phototropism, geotropism, thigmotropism aur chemotropism (hamara apna khaaka; kitab is jagah koi figure nahin chhapti).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har khaane mein dekhein pauda kis cheez ki taraf ya us se door barhta hai: shoot roshni ki taraf (positive phototropism), jar gravity ki taraf neeche (positive geotropism), tendril chhoone par sahare ke gird (thigmotropism), aur fungus ki hypha kisi kimiyai mawad ki taraf (chemotropism).

blocks.caption: Tropisms
rows: Shoot ke sire us ki taraf ugte hain
Tendrils sahare ke gird lipatti hain
Phaphoondi ke hyphae un ki taraf ugte hain

blocks.prompt: Ek beej andhere mein ulta boya jata hai. Peshgoi karein ke us ki jar aur shoot kis taraf ugte hain, aur har ek ke liye tropism aur us ka nishan batayein.
blocks.explanation: Jar mur kar neeche ugti hai: musbat geotropism. Shoot mur kar oopar ugta hai: manfi geotropism. Andhere mein roshni ka koi kirdar nahin, is liye phototropism shamil nahin.

items: Pode jagah nahin badal sakte, is liye muharrikat ka jawab nashonuma ki harkaton, tropisms, se dete hain: uzw ka muharrik ki taraf (musbat) ya us se door (manfi) murna.

Phototropism (roshni: shoots musbat, jarein manfi), geotropism (gravity: jarein musbat, shoots manfi), thigmotropism (chhoona: tendrils lipatti hain) aur chemotropism (kimiyai maddey: phaphoondi ke hyphae).
